name: Loretta's Brand New Job
storyline: When Elio, a politician who's living a happy and peaceful life with his wife, Loretta, takes up the position of editor-in-chief of his party's paper, trouble arises as a new writer, Fabro, joins the group. Fabro didn't come to the party to help Elio... quite the contrary, actually. He has his eyes set on Elio's position, and he's ready and willing to do anything to get it—including making Loretta his pawn. What will become of Loretta's brand-new job as Elio's secretary? And how will Elio thwart Fabro's diabolical schemes?
summary:
Loretta's husband Elio has started a promising new job at his political party's newspaper. However, a politician Elio used to work with is now coercing Elio to write positive articles about him, putting Elio's reputation at risk.

Elio must stop Fabro from realizing his diabolical plans, and it's up to you to investigate the town and uncover the truth from your fellow citizens! Experience a traditional slice-of-life RPG while you unearth the truths hidden behind Fabro's deceit. Stop Fabro and don't let him steal your position in the party!
